section_summary.extract_value: This section explores the relationship between ethnic identity, body appreciation (BAS), and eating disorder pathology in women, with Western beauty ideal internalization as a potential mediator. It reports a positive association between ethnic identity and body appreciation, and found that Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the links between ethnic identity and eating, shape, and weight concerns, but not body appreciation.

section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates the relationship between ethnic identity and various psychological constructs, including body appreciation, self-esteem, appearance evaluation, Western ideal beauty internalization, and eating concerns. It reports that ethnic identity was positively associated with body appreciation and self-esteem, and negatively associated with Western ideal beauty internalization and eating/shape/weight concerns. A mediation analysis was conducted to examine the role of Western beauty ideal internalization between ethnic identity and body appreciation/eating disorder pathology, with results presented in Table 4 (not provided). Table 3, which is provided, shows correlations between measures, including a correlation of -0.45 between Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and Body Mass Index (BMI).

It reports that ethnic identity was positively associated with body appreciation and self-esteem, and negatively associated with Western ideal beauty internalization and various eating/shape/weight concerns.
